output.reasoning: Role type: This is a Pre-Sales Applied AI Architect position, not a hands-on ML/NLP/AI engineering role. It does not involve building, training, or deploying ML systems as primary engineering output. It falls outside Ananya's target roles (Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, ML Engineer, Research Engineer). The compensation is listed as an OTE range of $275,000-$315,000, which signals a senior sales-engineering level. Ananya is a new grad finishing an MS in Computer Science (AI concentration) at Boston University in 2026-12. Her only professional experience is an 8-month ML Engineer co-op, so the 3+ years exclusion applies. Skills: The required section names only Python as a specific technology; the rest are generic (cloud architectures, LLM frameworks). So the skills test is skipped, and the verdict rests on role, level, location, and sponsorship. Location: Washington, DC is US-based, and Ananya is willing to relocate within the US, so location passes. Sponsorship: The posting states 'We do sponsor visas!' and does not disclaim sponsorship, so this passes for a candidate who needs sponsorship. Despite passing location and sponsorship, the role-type mismatch (pre-sales and customer-facing, not hands-on engineering) and the explicit 5+ years requirement make it NOT_RELEVANT.
